channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 8 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
  • ESA Open Space Innovation Platform (OSIP): rolling open call for ideas
    https://www.esa.int/Enabling_Support/Preparing_for_the_Future/Discovery_and_Preparation/The_Open_Space_Innovation_Platform_OSIP
    European Space Agency (ESA) · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by route and campaign. Successful ideas are supported through PhD or postdoctoral research co-funded by ESA and universities, early technology development activities, or system studies. Free to submit.
  • Luminos.AI Legal Engineering Fellowship (Fall 2026)
    https://www.luminos.ai/jobs/luminos-ai-fellowship-program-fall-2026
    Luminos.AI · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 35 per hour, part-time. No application fee.
  • Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    https://rorypecktrust.org/get-help/crisis/crisis-fund/
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.
  • IIE Scholar Rescue Fund (IIE-SRF) Fellowship for Threatened and Displaced Scholars
    https://www.iie.org/programs/scholar-rescue-fund/for-scholars/
    Institute of International Education (IIE), Scholar Rescue Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Fellowship of up to USD 30,000 for one year, paid towards a temporary academic position at a host institution; in most cases renewable for a second and final year. No application fee.
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• National Geographic x The Climate Pledge: Illuminating Climate Solutions RFP 2026
    https://www.nationalgeographic.org/society/grants-and-investments/rfp-illuminating-climate-solutions/
    National Geographic Society (in partnership with The Climate Pledge) · deadline Closed 25 May 2026 · Up to $100,000 per project (recommended cap of $20,000 if you have <=5 years of experience). Funds for project costs only, used over up to 2 years.
  • EHRI Conny Kristel Fellowship Programme 2026
    https://www.ehri-project.eu/ehri-eric-call-for-applications-conny-kristel-fellowship-programme-2026/
    EHRI-ERIC (European Holocaust Research Infrastructure) · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · Stipend for housing and living expenses + travel reimbursement (amount varies by host country)

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 8 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 20 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Fab City Awards 2026
    https://creativesunite.eu/article/submit-your-project-for-the-fab-city-awards
    Fab City · deadline Closed 29 Apr 2026 · €1,000 per category winner (3) + €1,500 Overall Impact Award + up to USD 600 in Seeed Studio products + mentoring + free FAB26 Boston ticket
  • O'Shaughnessy Fellowships
    https://www.osvfellowship.com/
    OSV Fellowship · deadline Closed 30 Apr 2026 · Up to $100,000
  • Internet Society Foundation: Research Grant Program 2026
    https://www.isocfoundation.org/2026/04/applications-open-for-the-research-grant-program/
    Internet Society Foundation · deadline Closed 22 May 2026 · $200,000 to $500,000 per project
  • Wikimedia Foundation Rapid Fund
    https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Grants:Project/Rapid
    Wikimedia Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Jul 2026 · $500 to $5,000 USD per grant (distributed in local-currency equivalent at time of application). Per-applicant cap $10,000/fiscal year; individuals may not hold multiple open Rapid Funds, organisations/groups limited to 2 open grants at a time.
  • Kapor Foundation Research Fellowship
    https://kaporfoundation.org/research-fellowship/
    Kapor Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Cash award (amount per project; first awards announced by 30 June 2026)
  • Pulitzer Center: Data Journalism Grants
    https://pulitzercenter.org/grants-fellowships/opportunities-journalists/data-journalism-grants
    Pulitzer Center on Crisis Reporting · deadline Rolling / undated · Typically $5,000 to $10,000+ per project (covers reporting hard costs; no salaries or equipment)
  • Pulitzer Center: AI Reporting Grants
    https://pulitzercenter.org/grants-fellowships/opportunities-journalists/ai-reporting-grants
    Pulitzer Center on Crisis Reporting · deadline Rolling / undated · Variable reporting hard costs (no salaries or equipment)
  • OTF Internet Freedom Fund
    https://www.opentech.fund/funds/internet-freedom-fund/
    Open Technology Fund (OTF) · deadline Rolling / undated · $10,000 to $900,000 (sweet spot $50,000 to $200,000)

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
